title: Noble Slovakian Mushroom Stew
description: A rich, molten one-pot stew featuring ovoli mushrooms and roasted pork, seasoned with smoked paprika and caraway for a deep Slovakian flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced pork belly and cook until browned and crisp, about 5 minutes.
Stir in sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, sauté for 4 minutes.
Mix in ovoli mushrooms, smoked paprika, and caraway seeds, cooking for another 2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock and bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in chopped fresh dill and season with salt and black pepper.
Adjust seasoning if needed and let the stew simmer uncovered for 5 minutes to thicken.
Serve hot, optionally with crusty bread for dipping.
